target_customer: Small and mid-sized home service contractors (roofing, exteriors, painting, remodeling) who need measurements, estimates and proposals
problem: Contractors lose time and accuracy turning jobsite information into measurements, takeoffs and estimates. Feldy captures the job by phone and produces estimates and documentation.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for contractors (pricing not found)
product_category: Field capture and AI estimating for home services

founders.name: Zayne Sagar
education: UC Berkeley, Applied Math/CS and Philosophy (YC page)
previous_startups: Construction-software company taken to 500K ARR with co-founder (per YC page; name not given, Dealroom names Aether Energy, unverified)
founders.background_notes: Founders met at UC Berkeley engineering school.

founders.name: Shelby Bons
education: UC Berkeley, Materials Science and Engineering
previous_startups: Construction-software company taken to 500K ARR with co-founder (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Previously on a theoretical physics PhD track, per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Computer vision and 3D capture from phone photos and scans plus estimate generation is demanding for a small team but built on available models and mobile sensors in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Contractor workflow and stored job data create some lock-in, but measurement and estimating features were offered by established tools like Hover and EagleView.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established measurement and photo documentation vendors already served roofers and contractors; no acquisition of Feldy found.

market_need_then: The YC page cites more than 2 million US home service businesses in an 800B+ market; the pain of manual takeoffs and estimates is described by comparison sites and vendors but no dated demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses feldy.ai, not a .com; acquisition details not found

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community content about the brand itself found; a Launch YC post and the product site are the only brand assets.

outcome_analysis: Feldy is an active Denver based startup from YC Winter 2024 that sells field capture and AI estimating to home service contractors. No priced funding round, exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is unknown. Founders have prior construction software experience, but competition from measurement incumbents is strong and public traction data is missing.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125K seed with no date or investors (same figure appears for other YC companies, so treated as the standard deal and unverified); not recorded as a round. Competition list left empty because search found only undated or 2026 vendor comparison pages, nothing dated near the batch; Hover and EagleView listed in takeover_risk are from comparison pages not dated to 2024. Founders' prior company named Aether Energy by Dealroom only. Website text shows featured on Launch YC but names no founders.
